Haryanvi Singer Ankit Baliyan Murdered; Two Accused Killed in Police Encounter

Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan was shot dead outside a gym in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh, by four assailants. The incident occurred after Baliyan left the gym, and approximately 10-15 rounds were fired. Following the murder, police launched a search for the accused. In a subsequent development, two suspected sharpshooters involved in Baliyan's murder were killed in a police encounter in Uttar Pradesh.
